table.retrieve:
Select	THeader.Transcode,
      SourceGodown = ( Select name from Godown where gcode = THeader.sgcode),
      TargetGodown = ( Select name from Godown where gcode = THeader.dgcode),
		THeader.Date,
		THeader.PostDate,
		UserName = (Select username from users where usercode = THeader.salesmancode),
		THeader.Remarks,
	 	THeader.Posted,
		itemalias = item.customicode,
		itemname = item.name, 
		TDetail.qty,
		price = Round(CASE :ai_pricetype WHEN 1 THEN TDetail.saleprice / TDetail.PackUnits WHEN 2 THEN TDetail.purprice / TDetail.PackUnits ELSE TDetail.avgprice END, 2),
		sourceqty=tdetail.sourcestock,
		targetqty=tdetail.targetstock
From  THeader, TDetail, Item

Where THeader.TransCode = TDetail.TransCode AND
      TDetail.Icode = Item.Icode AND
      THeader.TransCode Between :al_stcode AND :al_ltcode

Order By THeader.TransCode,TDetail.ID
